mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to concerns about future economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downward.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between GDPC1 growth and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves due to increased economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2% and the CPI is increasing by more than 0.3% per month, the combination signals an inflationary environment with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real returns are eroded.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.3% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary environment with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction effect between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending is expected to rise.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200,000 and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction effect between PAYEMS and UNRATE on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a month signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as it indicates a broader economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between HOUST decreases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth (GDPC1) is negative for two consecutive quarters and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1%, it signals a recessionary environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as markets anticipate fiscal stimulus and policy easing.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative for 2 quarters and FEDFUNDS < 1%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction effect between GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
